line: A swordsman crosses the river on the water and splits the current with a single stroke.
line_cn: 侠客踏水过江，一剑断流。

camera.expresses: The page is the stage; things are painted in
camera.serves: a thing forming; a line being read; a still decision

camera.expresses: Time and distance as one painting
camera.serves: a journey; a history; a process

camera.move: Lateral tracking, lead room, slow far parallax
High wide, a tiny figure in blank paper
camera.serves: loneliness; nature's scale; one life among many

camera.move: Low angle, dark mass towering, slow push-in with shake
Hard cut to an extreme close-up
camera.expresses: A break in the flow (the style's only hard cuts)
camera.serves: a decision; a shock; a memory

camera.move: Push into an ink bloom or mist
Pull back until a mark joins the whole
camera.expresses: The part was inside something larger

transitions: Transitions are ink blooms, pans along the scroll or mist;
never a generic dissolve or a wipe.
labels: Subtitles are inscriptions (题跋): a classical italic serif (Cormorant Garamond italic), ink-coloured, no box, ≤ 2 lines, placed in each shot's empty paper. A small vermilion square marks the start of each line. They appear wet and dry in a fraction of a second. Hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s).

Titles are written on the painting itself, in vertical columns in its empty space, with a vermilion 白文 seal drawn by code (lines knocked out of a slightly irregular red square, with ink-paste speckles). They move with the world.
Screen-space overlays reset the camera transform.
motion: Figures step at 12 fps (on twos); their position, the camera, blooms, ripples and splatter move on ones at 24 fps.

Stable strokes on twos: seed every stroke by its index and compute bristle breaks along normalized arc length × a fixed reference length, so flying-white gaps don't crawl every drawing. Allow only a small "boil" on the width noise.
Painted into existence: strokes appear in drawing order.

Stillness before action (when a decisive stroke is the event): hold, with at most a slow push-in, then let the stroke cross the frame in a few frames. Consequences start only after the stroke has finished.

native_moves.name: One stroke is everything
native_moves.fits: a product born from one line; a city growing from a single street; a day beginning with one bird.

native_moves.name: Emptiness is matter
native_moves.fits: a door opening in a wall; a crowd parting; an absence in a family portrait.

native_moves.name: Brush = gesture = action
native_moves.fits: a dancer's phrase that spells a word; a signature; a chef's knife work.

native_moves.name: Flying white (飞白)
native_moves.does: One fast dry stroke across the frame, strongest out of a silence.
native_moves.fits: a sprint finish; a decision; a comet.

native_moves.name: Ink bloom transition
native_moves.does: The next scene grows inside a spreading drop with a dark tide-line (noisy radial mask; world-anchored for elements, in the compositor for scenes).
native_moves.fits: memories; seasons; one era giving way to the next.

native_moves.name: The handscroll
native_moves.does: One long painting panned right to left, seen whole at last.
native_moves.fits: a history; a supply chain from field to hand; a day in a street.

native_moves.name: Splitting a mass
native_moves.does: Halves clipped either side of the cut; one rises and fades, one slumps; splatter stays.
native_moves.fits: breaking a record; a barrier falling; an idea splitting in two.

score.note: guqin-led, a breathy low flute, big drum; Chinese pentatonic
